claim: A solar-powered, three-axis-stabilized spacecraft bus exchanges commands and data with ground/payload, distributes conditioned power, closes an attitude-control loop, rejects heat, and optionally produces orbital thrust.
configuration_boundary: Propulsion is assumed for this example but is not universal to all spacecraft.
ADCS components are representative; mission-specific sensor and actuator sets vary.
No actual bus voltage, communications protocol, heat load, pointing performance or delta-v is claimed.
